reports.task:
完成以下局部调查问题，查找直接证据并说明适用范围：What percentage of their budget did the Kenyan counties allocate to agriculture?
背景声明：Kenyan counties allocated an average of 7.3% of budgets to agriculture.
声明日期（任务元数据）：23-7-2020
reports.status_reason: The county agriculture allocation table and full FY 2019/20 report hosted by Africa Check could not be retrieved (HTTP 403). No further investigation turns remain.

findings.statement: The available evidence does not establish what percentage Kenyan counties allocated to agriculture. E6 contains only a summary of the FY 2019/20 county budget implementation report, without agriculture allocation figures. E7 discusses the national agriculture budget, which cannot establish a county budget average. The claimed 7.3% remains unverified.
limitations: The applicable financial year, counties covered, agriculture allocation amounts, and method of calculating the claimed average remain unconfirmed.
Insufficient evidence does not demonstrate that the 7.3% claim is false.
